event.distribution_pattern: Product distribution is limited to Kwik Trip, Inc. owned and operated retail stores located in Iowa, Minnesota and Wisconsin only.

products.product_description: Kitchen Cravings Strawberry Parfait, Net Wt. 8.25 oz (234 g). UPC 39779-18435 Creamy Parfait Base, Strawberries with Sweetened Granola. Keep Refrigerated.
products.product_quantity: 10294 units from initial recall 7/21/16 & 1098 from expanded recall 7/20/16.
products.code_info: All sell by dates on or before 7/21/16 for initial recall and All sell by dates in commerce for the expanded recall.
products.reason_for_recall: Kwik Trip is recalling Kitchen Cravings Strawberry and Mixed Berry Parfaits because they may contain undeclared traces of peanuts. EXPANDED 7-29-2016 Kwik Trip has expanded their recall of Kitchen Craving Strawberry and Mixed Berry Parfaits because they may contain undeclared traces of peanuts or almonds.
